post-install-output: * Your MCP HTTP endpoint is available at <fg=green>/mcp</> and only accepts localhost by default.
Configure <fg=green>http.allowed_hosts</> in <fg=green>config/packages/mcp.yaml</> to allow other hostnames.
* The registry initially exposes all MCP services, including those from third-party bundles.
After adding your MCP services, restrict <fg=green>registry</> to their namespace(s), e.g. <fg=green>'App\Mcp\'</>.
Each namespace pattern must match at least one registered MCP service.

contents: # Use the MCP SDK attributes to declare tools, prompts and resources on your services.
# Once MCP services exist, restrict the registry to their namespace(s), e.g. 'App\Mcp\'.
# Namespace patterns must match at least one registered MCP service.
# '*' also exposes MCP services from third-party bundles over HTTP.
# Only localhost is allowed by default. Add hostnames without ports for remote access.
# Enable STDIO for clients such as Claude Desktop via bin/console mcp:server.
# Import the HTTP routes for the configured MCP servers.
